tickets.title: Raise Velvet Acorn Custody monthly transfer to $4,200
tickets.text: Raise the monthly checking transfer from $3,500 to $4,200 at Velvet Acorn Custody for Liora Pebblefizz, effective next cycle, to align with the preferred reserve level.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-07-24 to raise Velvet Acorn Custody monthly checking transfer $3,500-to-$4,200 next cycle.
